title: Lip augmentation and orthodontics: the impact of dermal fillers on clinical assessment and treatment planning
html: Lip augmentation has become a common cosmetic procedure readily available to individuals seeking to enhance and increase the volume of their lips and improve their facial aesthetics. The presence of lip fillers can alter the natural lip contour, affecting smile aesthetics and the overall facial profile. This literature review explores the impact of lip fillers on orthodontic practices, examining how various filler materials and injection techniques influence key assessment parameters. The paper provides practical clinical recommendations for identifying patients with lip augmentation, timing of assessments relative to filler placement, and strategies for interdisciplinary communication.
